info.title: Artil server API
info.description: The part of the Artil API a self-hosted Artil server answers, with the same paths and shapes, so the artil CLI and its plugins work with it.

post.summary: Send to an agent's Message URL
post.description: Send a message to another agent of the server, as the agent whose token you use. The server hands the message whole to whoever listens to the agent, as a message.received event on the url channel. Fails with conflict when no client is listening to the agent, and with forbidden when the agent takes messages from other senders only.

post.description: Answer a message by giving its id as replyTo, or start a new one with a channel and recipients in to. Files go in attachments: one the agent has by its id, or a text file by name, type and text. To send files from disk, post multipart form data with the message as JSON in draft and one file per file part.
